noteRegimes: Allergies: we remove the ingredients concerned, but always check labels, traces may be present (for example tree nuts in chocolate). Halal: remember to buy halal chicken.

Pâtes tout-en-une tomate-thon.title: One-pot tomato and tuna pasta
steps: Optional: fry the sliced onion in oil for 2 minutes.
Add the tin of tomatoes, 400 ml of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil.
Add 200 g of pasta. Cook for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often, until the liquid is almost absorbed.
Off the heat, add the flaked tuna (or whatever you have instead), pepper and the cheese.
Pâtes tout-en-une tomate-thon.swap: No tuna: sardines, chickpeas, beans or sweetcorn work too.

Riz sauté vide-frigo.title: Fridge-raid fried rice
steps: Cook the rice if needed (about 120 g uncooked), drain it and let it cool a little.
Fry the vegetables for 3 minutes in a little oil.
Push them to the side, crack 2 eggs into the space and scramble them for 1 minute.
Add the rice, stir over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, then season.
Riz sauté vide-frigo.swap: No eggs: tuna or chickpeas. No rice: cooked short pasta or couscous.

Curry express de légumineuses.title: Quick bean curry
steps: Optional: fry the onion in oil for 3 minutes.
Add 1 teaspoon of curry powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Add half a tin of tomatoes and the rinsed beans or lentils. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Off the heat, add a little milk or a yoghurt. Serve with rice, bread or couscous.
Curry express de légumineuses.swap: No lentils or chickpeas: any tinned beans will do.

Pain perdu anti-gaspi.title: No-waste French toast
steps: Beat 2 eggs with 150 ml of milk, then add sugar (sweet version) or salt and pepper (savoury version).
Dip each slice of stale bread for a few seconds on each side.
Fry until golden, 2 to 3 minutes on each side.
Pain perdu anti-gaspi.swap: No milk: water works too, the French toast will just be a bit less soft.

Omelette vide-frigo.title: Fridge-raid omelette
steps: Chop whatever you have into small pieces: vegetables, onion, leftover cooked potatoes.
Fry them for 3 to 5 minutes in a little oil.
Beat 3 or 4 eggs with salt and pepper, and pour them into the pan.
Cook over low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, without stirring, until the top is set.
Omelette vide-frigo.swap: If you have cheese, sprinkle it on just before the end.

Salade de semoule façon taboulé.title: Couscous salad, tabbouleh style
steps: Put 150 g of couscous in a bowl with a pinch of salt and a drizzle of oil.
Cover with the same volume of boiling water (kettle, hob or microwave). Cover for 5 minutes.
Fluff it up with a fork, add the drained vegetables and, if you have them, tuna or chickpeas.
Salade de semoule façon taboulé.swap: Keeps for 2 days in the fridge in a closed box: perfect for the next day's lunch.

Salade express sans cuisson.title: Quick no-cook salad
steps: Rinse and drain the beans or lentils.
Mix them with the tuna, sweetcorn or whatever you have.
Season with a drizzle of oil, salt, pepper and a little chopped onion if you have some.
Salade express sans cuisson.swap: No cooking at all: ideal if you have no hob and no microwave.

Soupe de légumes express.title: Quick vegetable soup
steps: Cut the vegetables and potatoes into small pieces.
Fry the onion in oil, add the vegetables and just cover with water. Add salt.
Cook for 15 to 20 minutes. If you have pasta or tinned lentils, add them for the last 10 minutes.
Mash with a fork for a thicker soup.
Soupe de légumes express.swap: Half a tin of tomatoes makes the soup tastier.

Riz au lait.title: Rice pudding
steps: Bring 500 ml of milk to a simmer with 2 tablespoons of sugar.
Add 70 g of rice and cook over very low heat for 30 minutes, stirring often.
The rice is ready when it is soft and the milk has thickened. Eat it warm or cold.
Riz au lait.swap: Short-grain rice is ideal, but long-grain works too.

Omelette en tasse au micro-ondes.title: Microwave mug omelette
steps: Beat 2 eggs in a large mug with a little milk, salt and pepper.
Add some cheese or a few drained vegetables if you like.
Heat for 1 minute, stir, then 30 to 60 seconds more until it is fully set.
Omelette en tasse au micro-ondes.swap: For anyone with just a microwave: a hot meal in 3 minutes.

Œufs pochés à la tomate.title: Eggs poached in tomato sauce
steps: Optional: fry the sliced onion in oil for 2 minutes.
Pour in the tin of tomatoes, a pinch of salt and spices. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Make 4 small hollows in the sauce and crack an egg into each one.
Cover and cook over low heat for 5 to 6 minutes, until the whites are set. Serve with bread.
Œufs pochés à la tomate.swap: No lid: a plate on top of the pan does the job.

Pâtes au fromage express.title: Quick cheesy pasta
steps: Cook 200 g of pasta in salted water, following the time on the packet.
Keep a small glass of the cooking water, then drain the pasta and put it back in the pan, off the heat.
Add grated or diced cheese, a splash of milk or cooking water, and pepper.
Stir until creamy.
Pâtes au fromage express.swap: No cheese: plain yoghurt, a drizzle of oil and lots of pepper make a creamy sauce.

Purée maison à la fourchette.title: Homemade fork-mashed potatoes
steps: Peel 4 or 5 potatoes and cut them into large chunks.
Cover with cold salted water and cook for 15 to 20 minutes: a knife should slide in easily.
Drain, put back in the pan and mash with a fork.
Add a little hot milk or a drizzle of oil, salt and pepper, then mix.
Purée maison à la fourchette.swap: Even better with grated cheese stirred in. Leftovers make an omelette the next day.

Pommes de terre sautées.title: Pan-fried potatoes
steps: Cut 4 potatoes into small cubes (no need to peel them if you wash them well).
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the pan and add the cubes in a single layer.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes over medium heat, then uncover and let them brown for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add salt and pepper. Add the onion for the last 5 minutes if you have some.
Pommes de terre sautées.swap: Fry an egg in a corner of the pan at the end: it's a complete meal.

Pomme de terre garnie au micro-ondes.title: Microwave jacket potato
steps: Wash 1 large potato per person and prick it 6 or 7 times with a fork.
Put it on a plate and heat for 5 minutes, turn it over, then 3 to 4 minutes more. It's cooked when a knife goes in easily.
Cut it in half, mash the inside a little, and add salt and pepper.
Top with what you have: cheese, tuna, yoghurt, beans or sweetcorn.
Pomme de terre garnie au micro-ondes.swap: Careful, it's very hot when it comes out: let it rest for 1 minute before cutting.

Semoule au lait.title: Semolina pudding
steps: Heat 500 ml of milk with 3 tablespoons of sugar.
When the milk simmers, sprinkle in 60 g of semolina while stirring.
Cook for 5 minutes over low heat, stirring all the time, until it thickens.
Pour into bowls. Eat it warm or cold.
Semoule au lait.swap: The quickest dessert from a food parcel: semolina cooks 4 times faster than rice.

Riz à la tomate tout-en-un.title: One-pot tomato rice
steps: Optional: fry the onion in oil for 2 minutes.
Add 150 g of rice and stir for 1 minute.
Pour in the tin of tomatoes, 300 ml of water, salt and spices. Cover.
Cook over low heat for 15 to 18 minutes, until the rice is tender. Add the tuna or beans at the end.
Riz à la tomate tout-en-un.swap: Stir now and then and add a little water if it sticks to the bottom.

Chili sans viande.title: Meat-free chilli
steps: Fry the onion in oil for 3 minutes if you have some.
Add 1 teaspoon of spices, the tin of tomatoes and the rinsed beans.
Add the drained sweetcorn if you have some. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes.
Serve with rice or bread, and a spoonful of yoghurt on top.
Chili sans viande.swap: No Mexican spices? Curry powder, paprika or just pepper work very well.

Rillettes de thon ou de sardines.title: Tuna or sardine spread
steps: Drain the tuna or sardines and mash them with a fork in a bowl.
Add 2 tablespoons of yoghurt (or soft cheese), pepper, and a little very finely chopped onion if you have some.
Mix well and spread on bread.
Rillettes de thon ou de sardines.swap: No cooking. Keeps for 1 day in the fridge in a closed box.

Houmous à la fourchette.title: Fork-mashed hummus
steps: Rinse and drain the chickpeas, keeping 3 tablespoons of their liquid.
Mash them well with a fork with 3 tablespoons of oil and a little of the liquid, until you get a paste.
Add salt, pepper, and a little crushed garlic or spices if you have some.
Eat it with bread or raw vegetables cut into sticks.
Houmous à la fourchette.swap: No chickpeas: white beans make a very smooth spread.

Soupe de lentilles à la tomate.title: Tomato and lentil soup
steps: Fry the onion in oil for 3 minutes if you have some, with 1 teaspoon of spices.
Add the drained lentils, the tin of tomatoes and 400 ml of water. Add salt.
Cook for 15 minutes over low heat.
Mash with a fork to thicken. Serve with bread and a spoonful of yoghurt.
Soupe de lentilles à la tomate.swap: Even better the next day: make double and keep it in the fridge for 3 days.

Pâtes au micro-ondes.title: Microwave pasta
steps: Put 100 g of short pasta per person in a large bowl, cover well with water and add salt.
Heat on full power for 4 minutes longer than the time on the packet, stirring every 4 minutes.
Drain carefully: the bowl is very hot, use a tea towel.
Add cheese, tomato sauce or tuna, stir and heat for 1 more minute.
Pâtes au micro-ondes.swap: Use a bowl much bigger than you need: the water foams and can overflow.

Bol de riz au micro-ondes.title: Microwave rice bowl
steps: Put 75 g of rice per person in a large bowl with twice its volume of water and some salt.
Heat for 10 to 12 minutes on full power, stirring halfway. Leave to rest, covered, for 2 minutes.
Add the flaked tuna (or beans) and the drained vegetables.
Season with a little soy sauce or oil. With an egg: beat it, mix it into the rice and heat for 1 more minute.
Bol de riz au micro-ondes.swap: The same bowl works with couscous: poured into boiling water, ready in 5 minutes.

Croque au fromage à la poêle.title: Pan-fried cheese toastie
steps: Put cheese between two slices of bread, and a little tuna if you have some.
Heat the pan with a few drops of oil.
Put the toastie in, press down with a spatula and let it brown for 2 to 3 minutes.
Turn it over and brown for 2 more minutes, until the cheese melts.
Croque au fromage à la poêle.swap: Deluxe version: dip the toastie in beaten egg before cooking it.

Riz au lait au micro-ondes.title: Microwave rice pudding
steps: Put 50 g of rice and 350 ml of milk in a very large bowl.
Heat for 4 minutes on full power, then stir.
Continue for 12 to 14 minutes on medium power, stirring every 3 minutes so it doesn't overflow.
Add 2 tablespoons of sugar, stir and leave to rest: it thickens as it cools.
Riz au lait au micro-ondes.swap: Keep an eye on it: milk rises fast. If it overflows, lower the power.

Salade de pâtes.title: Pasta salad
steps: Cook 200 g of short pasta in salted water, drain and rinse under cold water.
If you have eggs, cook them for 9 minutes in the pasta water: they'll be hard-boiled.
Mix the pasta with the tuna (or chickpeas) and the drained vegetables.
Season with oil, salt and pepper, or a yoghurt and pepper sauce.
Salade de pâtes.swap: Keeps for 2 days in the fridge: perfect for lunch at uni.

Porridge express.title: Quick porridge
steps: Put 50 g of rolled oats and 200 ml of milk (or water) in a large bowl.
Microwave for 1 minute, stir, then 1 minute more. On the hob: 3 minutes over low heat, stirring.
Add a mashed fruit, some apple sauce, a little sugar or a square of chocolate.
Porridge express.swap: A breakfast that keeps you going until lunch, for a few cents.

Crêpes.title: Crêpes
steps: In a bowl, mix 125 g of flour and 2 eggs, then gradually add 300 ml of milk, whisking with a fork.
Leave to rest for 10 minutes if you have time.
Lightly grease the hot pan with a little oil or butter, pour in a small ladle of batter and tilt the pan to spread it.
Cook for about 1 minute, flip and leave for 30 seconds. Fill with something sweet or savoury.
Crêpes.swap: Not enough milk: half milk, half water. Savoury version with cheese and ham.

Mug cake au chocolat.title: Chocolate mug cake
steps: In a large mug, mix 1 egg, 2 tablespoons of sugar and 2 tablespoons of milk or oil.
Add 4 tablespoons of flour and some chocolate pieces. Mix well.
Microwave for 1 minute, then 15 seconds at a time if needed: the cake should rise and stay soft in the middle.
Mug cake au chocolat.swap: No chocolate: a spoonful of apple sauce in the middle of the batter.

Nouilles sautées.title: Stir-fried noodles
steps: Cook the noodles for 3 minutes in a little boiling water in the pan, then drain them.
With chicken: cut it into small pieces and cook for 6 to 8 minutes in a little oil, until it's no longer pink inside.
Add the vegetables and fry them for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and 2 beaten eggs (or the tuna), stir for 2 minutes over high heat, then season with soy sauce.
Nouilles sautées.swap: Instant noodles work: only use half the seasoning sachet, it's very salty.

Pâtes crème et jambon.title: Creamy ham pasta
steps: Cook 200 g of pasta in salted water, then drain.
Put it back in the pan over low heat with 3 tablespoons of crème fraîche (or a little milk and cheese).
Add the diced ham and pepper, and stir for 1 minute.
Pâtes crème et jambon.swap: No ham: tuna or sweetcorn. Halal version: replace the ham with tuna.

Poulet au curry.title: Chicken curry
steps: Cut 250 g of chicken into pieces. Wash your hands after touching raw meat.
Brown it in a little oil for 8 minutes, with the onion if you have some. It must no longer be pink inside.
Add 1 teaspoon of curry powder and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in 3 tablespoons of cream (or a yoghurt off the heat, or half a tin of tomatoes) and simmer for 5 minutes. Serve with rice or bread.
Poulet au curry.swap: No chicken: chickpeas make an equally good curry (see the quick bean curry).

Potatoes au four ou à l'air fryer.title: Oven or air-fryer potato wedges
steps: Wash 3 or 4 potatoes and cut them into wedges, skin on.
Mix them with 1 tablespoon of oil, salt and spices.
Air fryer: 18 to 20 minutes at 200 °C, shaking the basket halfway. Oven: 30 minutes at 220 °C, turning them once.
Serve with a yoghurt, salt and pepper dip.
Potatoes au four ou à l'air fryer.swap: Sweet potatoes or carrots can be cooked the same way.

Pois chiches croustillants.title: Crispy chickpeas
steps: Rinse the chickpeas and dry them well with a clean tea towel.
Mix them with 1 tablespoon of oil, salt and spices.
Air fryer: 12 to 15 minutes at 200 °C, shaking twice. Oven: 25 minutes at 200 °C.
Pois chiches croustillants.swap: Great as a snack, or on a salad or soup. They keep for 2 days in a box, a little less crispy.

Œufs cocotte.title: Baked eggs in a ramekin
steps: Put 1 tablespoon of cream in the bottom of a ramekin, and add a little ham or vegetables if you have some.
Crack 1 or 2 eggs on top, add salt, pepper and a little cheese.
Oven: 10 to 12 minutes at 180 °C. Air fryer: 8 minutes at 160 °C. Microwave: prick the yolk with a fork (otherwise it can burst), then heat for 45 seconds and add 15 seconds if needed.
Serve with bread for dipping.
Œufs cocotte.swap: In the microwave, cover the ramekin with a plate to avoid splatters.

Soupe de nouilles express.title: Quick noodle soup
steps: Put the noodles, half a crumbled stock cube and a few drained vegetables in a large bowl.
Pour in 400 ml of boiling water (kettle, hob or microwave).
Cover for 3 to 4 minutes, then stir.
Soupe de nouilles express.swap: Add a spoonful of soy sauce or a little curry powder for a change.

Salade de fruits au yaourt.title: Fruit salad with yoghurt
steps: Cut the fruit into pieces.
Mix it with a yoghurt or some apple sauce.
Add a few rolled oats for crunch.
Salade de fruits au yaourt.swap: Slightly bruised fruit is perfect here: the ultimate no-waste recipe.

Smoothie aux fruits.title: Fruit smoothie
steps: Put 1 banana or another fruit, cut into pieces, in the blender.
Add 200 ml of milk, or a yoghurt with a little water.
Add 1 tablespoon of rolled oats or peanut butter if you like, then blend for 30 seconds.
Smoothie aux fruits.swap: Overripe fruit is perfect: freeze it in pieces for a really cold smoothie.

Pancakes.title: Pancakes
steps: In a bowl, mix 150 g of flour, 1 egg and 2 tablespoons of sugar.
Gradually add 200 ml of milk while stirring: the batter should stay thick.
Heat the pan with a little oil and pour in a small ladle of batter per pancake.
When bubbles appear, after about 2 minutes, flip it and cook for 1 minute.
Pancakes.swap: Top with fruit, apple sauce, chocolate or peanut butter.

Nouilles sauce cacahuète.title: Peanut sauce noodles
steps: Cook the noodles or pasta, then drain them, keeping a small glass of the cooking water.
In the pan, mix 2 tablespoons of peanut butter, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and a little cooking water.
Put the noodles back, add the vegetables and stir for 1 minute over low heat.
Nouilles sauce cacahuète.swap: No soy sauce: a little salt and a splash of vinegar or lemon.

Tartine cacahuète-banane.title: Peanut butter and banana toast
steps: Toast the bread if you have a toaster (optional).
Spread a layer of peanut butter.
Add slices of banana or another fruit.
Tartine cacahuète-banane.swap: A filling breakfast or snack, high in protein.

Pain grillé à la tomate.title: Tomato toast
steps: Toast the slices of bread: toaster, dry frying pan or oven.
Rub them with a little garlic if you have some.
Spread crushed tomato on top (tinned, or a grated fresh tomato), a drizzle of oil and salt.
Pain grillé à la tomate.swap: Add tuna or cheese to make it a proper meal.

Galettes de pommes de terre.title: Potato rösti
steps: Grate 3 potatoes (or cut them into very small pieces) and squeeze them in a clean tea towel to remove the water.
Mix with 1 egg, salt, pepper and a little onion if you have some.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in the pan and shape small flat patties.
Cook for 5 minutes on each side over medium heat, until nicely golden.
Galettes de pommes de terre.swap: No egg: 2 tablespoons of flour are enough to hold them together.

Salade de riz.title: Rice salad
steps: Cook 150 g of rice in salted water, drain it and rinse under cold water.
Mix it with the tuna (or hard-boiled eggs, beans) and the drained vegetables.
Season with oil, salt and pepper.
Salade de riz.swap: Put it in the fridge straight away and eat it the same day: cooked rice doesn't keep long.

Pomme cuite.title: Baked apple
steps: Wash 1 apple or pear per person and remove the core with a knife.
Put it in a bowl, add a little sugar and 1 tablespoon of water.
Heat for 3 to 4 minutes in the microwave (or 25 minutes in the oven at 180 °C), until soft.
Pomme cuite.swap: Delicious with a yoghurt or a few rolled oats: a dessert for a few cents.

Les dates sur les emballages.texte: "Use by": don't go past the date, it's a safety matter (meat, fresh fish, fresh dairy). "Best before": the product is still fine after the date if it has been stored properly (pasta, rice, tins, biscuits).

Une conserve ouverte.texte: Don't keep leftovers in the metal tin: put them in a bowl or a closed box in the fridge, and eat them within 2 to 3 days.

Une conserve abîmée.texte: A swollen, leaking or strange-smelling tin when opened: throw it away without tasting. A slightly dented but intact tin is still fine.

Le riz cuit.texte: Put it in the fridge within an hour of cooking and eat it within 24 hours. Reheat it until piping hot, only once.

Les restes de plats cuisinés.texte: Into the fridge within 2 hours of cooking, in a closed box, and eat within 2 to 3 days. To keep them longer, freeze them in portions.

Le pain.texte: Slice it and freeze it: it can be toasted straight from the freezer. When stale, it makes great French toast.

Le lait ouvert.texte: In the fridge, closed, and finish it within the few days shown on the carton (often 3 days).

Les œufs.texte: Keep them away from temperature changes, ideally in the fridge. A cracked egg should be cooked straight away, and well cooked.

Le fromage.texte: Well wrapped in the fridge. Grated cheese can be frozen and used without thawing.

La viande crue.texte: In the coldest part of the fridge, and cook it before the use-by date. Never refreeze thawed raw meat. Wash your hands after touching it.

Les fruits et légumes.texte: A spot of mould on a firm vegetable (carrot, cabbage, potato): cut well around it. On a soft fruit or vegetable (tomato, peach, strawberry): throw it away. Potatoes and onions keep in a dry, dark place, not in the fridge.

Les fruits trop mûrs.texte: Perfect for porridge, fruit salad or French toast. You can also freeze them in pieces.

Bien congeler.texte: Freeze in small portions and write the date on them. Thaw in the fridge, not on the table.

Le frigo.texte: Set it to around 4 °C and don't overfill it: air needs to circulate. Put what goes off first at the front.
